correctness.rationale: The construction makes a stable genus-eleven curve with graph containing 20 degree-three vertices and 30 edges, and all S5×C2 graph automorphisms lift uniquely. Stable-curve deformation theory with finite-field descent yields regular thickness-one semistable smoothings. The equivariant Raynaud monodromy pairing identifies rational components with fixed graph Jacobian classes. Perfectness reduces them to cokernels of [R | P-I], and exact integer Smith forms were checked for all 14 types using two sink choices, with graph automorphism actions checked and all 240 symmetries enumerated.

value.rationale: This is the complete arithmetic local Tamagawa group classification of a single canonical maximally degenerate boundary point in genus-eleven stable-curve moduli, including all fourteen twists under its full 240-element symmetry group. These exact integral groups are not determined by known geometric critical-group factors; complementation changes their rational sizes dramatically, including a minimal group of order two. No general theorem beyond this natural classification is required.
